descriptions.en: After the unforgettable summer memories you’ve made half a year ago, Yui, Rio, and Miyuki are back. With the change of seasons and the cold falling snow, a new page to your story is about to begin.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 光阴似箭，那次令人难忘的夏日回忆转眼间就已经是半年前的事情了。在这个寒假，我们的主人公又回到了乡下，与莉音姐姐，结衣姐姐和美雪姑姑再续前缘，为这个浪漫的故事写下了新的篇章。
descriptions.ja: 忘れられない夏の思い出から半年経った今、また結衣、莉音、美雪 みんなに会える！ 季節も新たに雪が舞い落ちる中あなたの新しい物語が始まる。

descriptions.en: The most complete and authentic official WRC simulation yet. New physics for all surfaces, a completely redesigned career mode, dynamic weather conditions, 50 teams, 14 countries, 100 tracks, weekly challenges and an eSports mode…
